description: The bar chart illustrates the "Bias Percentage" across three distinct categories: Sports, Community, and Healthcare. The horizontal axis displays these categories from left to right without a specific alphabetical or value-based sorting order. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Bias Percentage," utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 70 with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. The data is presented using grouped and stacked bars, with three stacked bars per category group. According to the legend, the bottom segments of the bars represent "Before" conditions using solid colors, while the top segments represent "After" conditions using hatched patterns. In each group, the left bar features a solid light grey-blue bottom segment ("No Contact Before") and a hatched dark grey-blue top segment ("No Contact After"). The middle bar features a solid light red bottom segment ("Positive Contact Before") and a hatched dark red top segment ("Positive Contact After"). The right bar features a solid light blue bottom segment ("Negative Contact Before") and a hatched dark blue top segment, though the specific text for this final legend entry is obscured by a grey blur. Every bar segment is annotated with its exact numerical value; the bottom segment values are printed in regular text inside the top edge of the solid bars, while the top segment values are printed in bold text directly above the bars. In the Sports category, the bottom values are 45.42, 43.65, and 50.05, with corresponding top values of 7.45, 8.31, and 8.33. In the Community category, the bottom values are 38.08, 35.38, and 40.79, with top values of 0.00, 0.01, and 0.00. In the Healthcare category, the bottom values are 40.70, 37.51, and 46.73, with top values of 0.00, 0.01, and 0.11. The shortest overall stacked bar is the middle bar in the Community category, while the tallest overall stacked bar is the right bar in the Sports category.
